meta.title: Speak Plus City
meta.note: All game texts live here. Edit them with editor.html (no code needed), or by hand. There must be exactly 48 squares; squares 0, 12, 24 and 36 are the corners.

chance.text: Say three foods you like → collect $100.
Say your name, your age and where you live → collect $50.
Count from 10 to 20 in English → collect $50.
Say five colours you can see in the room → collect $100.
Ask the player on your left: "What's your favourite animal?" → you both collect $50.
Say "Thank you very much!" to the bank → collect $50.
You lost your wallet! Say "Excuse me, I lost my wallet." → pay only $20 (or $50 if you can't).
Say what you ate for breakfast → collect $100.
Say three things in your bag → collect $100.
Give $50 to the town fund and say "This is for our town!"
Say the day, the date and the weather today → collect $100.
Ask another player: "Can I have $50, please?" If they say yes, they pay you.
chance.note: If the other player agrees, move $50 in the Bank tab.

chance.text: Say what you did last weekend in one sentence → collect $100.
Talk about your last holiday for 30 seconds → collect $200.
Convince another player to give you a property (or $100).
chance.note: If they agree, move the property or the money.

chance.text: Describe one of your properties so well that someone wants to buy it.
chance.note: If someone wants it, start a trade.

chance.text: Ask the player on your left three questions about their weekend → collect $150.
Apologize to the bank for being late with a payment → pay only half the tax ($50 instead of $100).
Your phone is broken. Explain the problem to the shop → pay $50 for repairs (or $100 if they don't understand).
Recommend a restaurant to the class: say where, what to eat and why → collect $150.
Compare two seasons: "I prefer … because …" → collect $150.
Tell us about a time you were late. What happened? → collect $150.
Invite another player to dinner. They must accept or politely refuse → you both collect $50.
Explain how to get from here to the nearest station → collect $150.
It's your birthday! Tell us how you usually celebrate → every player gives you $20.
chance.note: Move $20 from each player in the Bank tab.

chance.text: Donate to the town fund: say why our town needs a new park → pay $100 into the fund.
Give a 45-second speech: "The best invention of all time is…" → collect $250.
Persuade the bank to lower your rent forever. If the class votes yes, your next rent is free.
chance.note: If the class agrees, approve the player's next rent with $0.

chance.text: Tell a short story that starts with "I never expected…" → collect $200.
Argue for 30 seconds that homework should be banned. Then argue against it → collect $250.
Make a complaint to the hotel manager (the teacher) about your room → get $150 compensation.
Explain a Japanese custom so a foreigner really understands it → collect $200.
Negotiate: offer another player a deal they can't refuse. If they accept, the bank adds $100 for you.
Tax inspection! Justify all your spending in 30 seconds → pay $50 (or $150 if the bank isn't convinced).
Describe your town 20 years in the future using "will" and "might" → collect $200.
Interview the player on your right for a job at your company. Ask at least four questions → collect $200.
Give advice to someone moving to Japan: three dos and three don'ts → collect $200.
Sell an everyday object (a pen, a cup…) as if it were the best product in the world → collect $250.

mystery.text: Describe this picture. What can you see?
Describe this picture. What are the people doing?
Describe the picture and imagine what happened just before it.
Tell the story of this picture from left to right.
Tell a story with all these pictures. Use the past tense.
Talk for 20 seconds: My family.
Talk for 20 seconds: My favourite food.
Talk for 20 seconds: My room.
Talk for 30 seconds: A place I want to visit.
Talk for 30 seconds: My morning routine.
Talk for 30 seconds: Something I bought recently.
Talk for 45 seconds: Is social media good or bad for us?
Talk for 45 seconds: The most important lesson I have learned.
Two truths and a lie: say three sentences about yourself. The others guess the lie. If they guess wrong, you win!
Two truths and a lie about your childhood. If nobody finds the lie, you win!
Explain the word without saying it. Your team guesses.
Explain the word without saying it. Your team guesses.
Explain the word without saying it. Your team guesses.
Explain the word without saying the forbidden words.
Explain the word without saying the forbidden words.
Explain the word without saying the forbidden words.
Explain the word without saying the forbidden words.
Explain the word without saying the forbidden words.
Explain the word without saying the forbidden words.
Role play with the teacher: you are a customer, the teacher is a shop assistant. Return something you bought.

missions.text: Own 3 properties in the same colour group.
Make a trade with every other player at least once.
Own a property in 4 different colour groups.
Have more than $1,000 at the end of the game.
Ask 5 different players a question that starts with "Have you ever…?"
Buy a property from the Black Market, or own the Airport.
Get someone to say "That's a great idea!" without asking them to.
Pay rent at least 3 times without complaining (stay polite!).
Own both Train Station and Harbour.
Give a compliment to every player during the game.

rules: Every sentence must include a polite word (please, thank you, excuse me…).
Use the past tense when you can.
Say the name of the person you are talking to.
Every sentence must have at least 6 words.
Ask a question before you do anything.
No Japanese at all — not even "eto"!
Use "I think…" or "In my opinion…" at least once.
Every request must start with "Could I…" or "Would you…".
Use a number in every sentence.
Give a reason with "because" for every action.
Compliment someone before you pay them.
Whisper! Speak very quietly this round.

jailChallenges.text: Say three things you did yesterday.
Say your favourite food, colour and animal.
Say "Sorry, I was late. Can I go, please?"
Explain why you were taking such a long coffee break.
Tell the boss (the teacher) three reasons why you should go back to work.
Describe your favourite drink so well that we all want one.
Persuade the boss you deserve a promotion, not a break.
Make an excuse so creative that the class believes you.
Apologise formally and promise to change, with three concrete promises.

buy.label: Buy
buy.task: Ask the bank to buy {name} for {price}.
buy.stretch: Say why you want it and what you will do with it.
frames: I'd like to buy {name} for {price}, please.
examples: I'd like to buy {name} for {price}, please. I love this place!

pass.label: Pass
pass.task: Say you don't want {name}. It goes to auction!
pass.stretch: Explain politely why you are not buying it.
frames: No, thank you. I don't want {name}.
I'll pass, thanks. It's too expensive.
examples: I'll pass this time, thanks. Let's have an auction!

rent.label: Pay rent
rent.stretch: Make some small talk with {owner} while you pay.
frames: Here you are. Thank you for having me at {name}.
Sorry, can I pay you next time?
examples: Here's {amount}, {owner}. {name} is a really nice place!

card.label: Draw card
card.task: Draw a Chance card and do what it says.
card.stretch: Speak in full sentences and add details.
examples: OK, I'll draw a card. Wish me luck!

mystery.label: Take the challenge
frames: In the picture, there is / there are ___.
examples: In the picture, there is a dog on the beach. It's sunny.

bank_tax.label: Talk to the bank
bank_tax.task: Pay {amount} tax. You can ask for a discount!
bank_tax.stretch: Persuade the bank with a good reason.
frames: Could I have a discount, please?
examples: Could I pay only half, please? I spent a lot on my café this month.

bank_bonus.label: Talk to the bank
bank_bonus.task: City Hall has a {amount} bonus for you. Thank the mayor (the teacher)!
bank_bonus.stretch: Say what you will do with the money.
frames: Thank you very much for the bonus!
examples: Thank you so much! I will use it to buy a new shop.

bank_loan.label: Talk to the bank
bank_loan.task: The bank can lend you money. Ask for a loan, or say no thanks.
bank_loan.stretch: Explain what the money is for and when you will pay it back.
frames: I will pay it back in ___ turns.
No, thank you. I don't need a loan.
examples: Could I borrow {amount}, please? I want to buy the Airport. I'll pay it back soon.

jail.label: Speak your way out
jail.task: You are on a Coffee Break! Speak your way out: {challenge}
frames: Can I go back to work, please?
examples: Sorry, I drank too much coffee! Can I go now, please?

festival.label: Festival talk
festival.task: Welcome to the Town Festival! Tell us about a festival or party you enjoyed.
festival.stretch: Say when, where, who with and why it was fun.
examples: Last summer I went to a fireworks festival with my friends. It was beautiful.

blackmarket.label: Open the Black Market
blackmarket.task: A secret seller is here! Open the Black Market.
blackmarket.stretch: Prepare your best pitch to buy the rare item.
frames: I'd like to see the Black Market.
examples: Psst… what do you have for me today?

trade.label: Trade
trade.task: Make a deal with another player.
examples: Would you trade Sushi Bar for Pizza Place plus $50?

loan.label: Ask for a loan
loan.task: Ask the bank for a loan.
loan.stretch: Persuade the bank: how much, why, and when you'll pay back.
frames: I will pay it back in ___ turns.
examples: Could I borrow $300, please? I'll pay it back in three turns.

mortgage.label: Mortgage
mortgage.task: Ask the bank to mortgage one of your properties for cash.
frames: How much can I get for it?
examples: I'd like to mortgage the Flower Shop, please. How much can I get?

discount.label: Ask for a discount
discount.task: Ask the bank for a discount.
frames: Could I have a discount, please?
examples: Could I have a small discount? I've bought three properties already!

bid.label: Auction
frames: Too expensive for me. I'm out.

end.label: End turn
end.stretch: Say what you did this turn.
frames: That's all for me. Your turn, ___!
examples: That's all for me. Your turn, Ken!
